about_the_game:
Dominate the league in EA SPORTS™ Madden NFL 26. Years of NFL game data powers next-level coaching, QB authenticity, and explosive gameplay. Every game is a new challenge on your path to becoming an NFL legend.

This game includes optional in-game purchases of virtual currency that can be used to acquire virtual in-game items, including a random selection of virtual in-game items.
detailed_description:
EA SPORTS™ Madden NFL 26



EA SPORTS™ Madden NFL 26 Deluxe Edition + Limited Time Bonus



Pre-purchase* the EA SPORTS™ Madden NFL 26 Deluxe Edition by July 24 and receive a Season 1 Elite Player Item and additional content:

  • 3-day early access
  • Early Access Ultimate Team Challenges
  • 4,600 Madden Points
  • MUT Cover Athlete Elite Player Item
  • Franchise Coach Ability Points
  • Player Card Exclusive Item
  • Superstar Legendary XP Boost


EA SPORTS™ Madden NFL 26 Standard Edition


About the Game

Dominate the league in EA SPORTS™ Madden NFL 26. Years of NFL game data powers next-level coaching, QB authenticity, and explosive gameplay. Every game is a new challenge on your path to becoming an NFL legend.

This game includes optional in-game purchases of virtual currency that can be used to acquire virtual in-game items, including a random selection of virtual in-game items.

legal_notice:
*This promotional offer expires July 24, 2025 11:59 pm Eastern Time. Good only for new purchases of Madden NFL 26 Deluxe Edition (“Product”) from the ea.com store, EA app (ea.com/ea-app) or participating retailers. You must redeem your single-use code (if a code is required), log into the game, and log into Ultimate Team, Superstar, NFL Team Pass, and/or Franchise modes while connected to EA servers (together these steps are referred to as “redeem”) to access pre-purchase content. Season 1 Elite Player Item provides the choice of one Season 1 Elite Player item from a select list of player items. All pre-purchase and Deluxe Edition content for use with one EA account and is non-transferrable. All player items and packs for use in the Madden Ultimate Team game mode (“MUT”). All MUT player items are non-auctionable and non-tradeable. MUT items may also require logging into the MUT in-game store. Some content may require gameplay to unlock. Access to content may require registration with a single-use code. Consult your retailer for distribution details. For retail pre-purchases, see retailer for early access distribution details and pick-up time. For digital pre-purchases, Product will be available to download once early access period (including the early access Solo Challenge in MUT) begins on August 11, 2025 12:00 pm Eastern Time to August 14, 2025 11:59 am. Early access (including the Early Access Solo Challenges in MUT) will not be available if you redeem after August 14, 2025. All other pre-purchase content will not be available if you redeem after August 14, 2026. Offer has no cash value and may not be substituted, exchanged, or sold for cash, goods, or services. May not be combined with other offers or prepaid card redeemable for the applicable content unless expressly authorized by EA. Customer is responsible for applicable sales tax. Void where prohibited, taxed, or restricted by law.
